$comment: THE declaration of the channel EQ's three plugins, omx-eq8, omx-eq16 and omx-eq32: ONE file for three band counts (tools/variants.mjs), the folders plugins/omx-eq8, omx-eq16 and omx-eq32 hold only what tools/gen.mjs writes from it. Its parameters are by reference to omx-contract's eq kernel and bind by name to omx-dsp's instance face; the per-band ones repeat for every band. Parameter order is append-only.
name: omx eq
description: The OpenMixer console's channel EQ, {bands}-band form: {bands} parametric bands (bell, shelves, notch, all-pass) and a high-pass and a low-pass filter at 12 or 24 dB/oct, stereo, zero latency; every band ships off, so a racked instance is a wire.
summary: The console's channel EQ in its {bands}-band form: {bands} parametric bands (bell, shelves, notch, all-pass) plus high- and low-pass filters at 12 or 24 dB/oct. Stereo, zero latency, 44.1 to 192 kHz.
manual: | High-pass | on/off, 20 to 1000 Hz, 12 or 24 dB/oct |
| Low-pass | on/off, 1 to 20 kHz, 12 or 24 dB/oct |
| Bands 1 to {bands} | each on/off, type, frequency (20 Hz to 20 kHz), gain (±15 dB), Q (0.3 to 8, a notch to 116) |
